events.verdict: Harrison (CHI) legally contests Hollis-Jefferson's (BKN) shot attempt near the rim; however, Portis (CHI) creates contact with Hollis-Jefferson's arm during his upward shooting motion, affecting the shot.
Carter Jr. (CHI) legally contests Harris' (BKN) driving shot attempt.
Holiday (CHI) legally moves alongside Harris' (BKN) body as he makes marginal contact during the shot attempt.
RLS shows Carter Jr. (CHI) makes slight contact with Harris' (BKN) arm making initial contact to the ball, but does not affect his ability to make the pass.
Harrison (CHI) makes contact with Allen's (BKN) right forearm after the release of his shot attempt and does not affect his ability to follow through naturally.
Markkanen (CHI) has his arm slightly outside the frame of his body when he makes marginal contact to Dinwiddie's (BKN) front, but does not affect his ability to defend.
Markkanen (CHI) makes marginal contact with his forearm to Hollis-Jefferson's (BKN) front during the drive.
[Observable in enhanced video] Markkanen (CHI) lifts and re-plants his pivot foot to the floor prior to the start of his dribble.
Dinwiddie (BKN) has a marginal resting hand to Dunn's (CHI) off-arm that he is able to move through to get to his natural shooting motion.
Allen (BKN) makes hand-on-ball contact with Carter Jr. (CHI) during the put-back attempt.
Carter Jr. (CHI) makes inadvertent contact with his right elbow to Hollis-Jefferson's (BKN) face during the rebound.
There is inconclusive video evidence determining whether or not Dinwiddie's (BKN) right heel steps out of bounds during his drive along the baseline.
Carter Jr. (CHI) places his left forearm to Dinwiddie's (BKN) front and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR.
Allen (BKN) sets the screen on Dunn (CHI) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Dunn (CHI) makes marginal body contact with Harris (BKN) after his release that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Dunn (CHI) is not in an established picking position as he delivers contact to Hollis-Jefferson (BKN) during the dribble hand-off.
Carter Jr. (CHI) makes marginal contact with Allen (BKN) as he moves to set the screen without affecting his FOM.
Dinwiddie (BKN) makes marginal contact with Holiday (CHI) during the inbound.
BKN fails to release the shot attempt prior to the expiration of the shot clock.
Markkanen (CHI) makes incidental contact with Harris (BKN) as they each attempt to retrieve the loose ball.
Dinwiddie (BKN) makes marginal contact with Dunn's (CHI) front prior to cleanly deflecting the ball during the hand-off.
Hollis-Jefferson (BKN) and Markkanen (CHI) make incidental contact as they both go for the loose ball.
Dunn (CHI) briefly places his arm around Dinwiddie's (BKN) midsection without affecting his SQBR before releasing.
Dunn (CHI) commits the take foul on Dinwiddie (BKN).
Harris (BKN) and Markkanen (CHI) engage and disengage during the inbound.
